propositions: A new generator script must read config schema, deprecation registry, and secret-name inventory to produce fully-generated config-reference and security docs that stay current with the registries.
The generator must preserve docs/config.md unchanged so all its existing consumers (tests with anchor links and content assertions) remain intact.
Both generated docs must carry a top-of-file banner naming the generator command and register in both the GENERATED map and docs/README.md table for parity gating.
A drift-check mode must fail when generated docs become stale, run under make test with no CI dependency, and handle CRLF newlines without false failures.

All required topics (precedence, source, lifecycle, restart/redeploy rotation, native refresh, observability exception, subprocess limitations, behavior deltas, MCP/CLI exposure) must be covered by anchors across the two new docs.
